Why Did Bloom Energy Stock More Than Triple In A Year?
summary: Bloom Energy (BE) stock gained 228% over the past year, against 16.7% for the S&P 500. The record second quarter it reported in July came late in that run. Over those twelve months Bloom took a business built on power for hospitals and factories and made it a supplier the major U.S. hyperscalers now approve. Today's price assumes that keeps paying.
